# PiTTy 1.1.2

## Reliable compaction

Compaction now accepts the first extension-supplied summary. Later compactors no longer perform another summary pass or replace the completed result. Every extension still receives the completion event.

A subagent notification received during compaction waits until the saved context is ready before starting the main agent. Cancelled or failed manual compaction leaves pending input queued.

The fixes ship in PiTTy's managed Pi runtime. Existing processes need a restart to load them. Explicit upstream Pi overrides keep using the selected upstream runtime.

```sh
pitty upgrade --version 1.1.2
```

The next PiTTy launch activates the staged update.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mistrjirka/PiTTy/compare/v1.1.1...v1.1.2)
